messages:
perf-ci-bot: nightly-perf: Alert: small-batch p95 increased by 38% vs baseline (job: nightly/bench-small-batch, run: 2026-03-17T02:00Z) https://ci.redwood.example/runs/6789
Sam: ugh, noticed that in the dashboard too. p50 is fine, p95 spike looks like a tail-regression. starting triage. who can help look at traces?
Maya: I can take point for initial profiling. can you paste the failing job id or link to artifacts?
Sam: link above has logs + traces but perf-bot also uploaded flamegraphs: https://storage.redwood.example/perf/6789/flamegraph.svg
Cheng: quick thought — yesterday we merged PR #3421 (attention kernel rewrite). commit 9a3f2d4 changed fused-matmul scheduling. could be related.
Lena: saw a couple of CUDA WARNINGS in the same window: "CUFFT plan rebuild" and some memory fragmentation traces. putting that on my list to check.
Maya: grabbing artifacts now. re-running a targeted benchmark on a dev node with env VARS: 
```
CI_JOB=bench-small-batch PERF_TRACE=1 ./run_bench.sh --commit 9a3f2d4
```
Maya: also trying the previous commit for diff: 8f7b1c2 (pre-kernel-change).
perf-ci-bot: reserved dev nodes available: gpu-dev-05, gpu-dev-07. TTL: 2h.
Cheng: if Maya repros, can you run samplings + kv-cache heatmap? that helped last time.
Maya: got a repro on gpu-dev-05. p95 reproduces locally. collecting perf traces now.
Sam: great. once you have flamegraphs, upload and paste link here. if it's the kernel change we should consider an emergency revert on Dedicated until fix.
Maya: uploaded new artifacts: https://storage.redwood.example/perf/6789/repro-2026-03-17/flamegraph.svg
Maya: evening glance: heavy stacks in attention::compute -> fused_matmul::warp. looks suspicious.
Cheng: can you try a quick build with the old scheduling flag? set env SCHEDULE_MODE=legacy and rerun.
Maya: running with SCHEDULE_MODE=legacy now.
Lena: i'm pulling node-level metrics (GPU throttling, ECC errs) — nothing obvious yet.
Maya: with legacy schedule p95 drops back to baseline. runs: 
- 9a3f2d4 (current): p95 = 220ms
- with SCHEDULE_MODE=legacy: p95 = 145ms
- 8f7b1c2 (pre-change): p95 = 140ms
Sam: that points strongly at scheduling change. Cheng, can you prepare a short revert PR or patch that restores old schedule while we fix the kernel rewrite?
Cheng: will do. prepping PR now. target branch: release/hotfix-177100.
infra-bot: patch-builder started for branch release/hotfix-177100 (job 6790).
Maya: also adding a perf regression test that runs small-batch nightly under both schedule modes, so we catch this earlier. PR to bench suite incoming.
Sam: action items: (1) Cheng opens hotfix PR to revert scheduling change, (2) Maya adds guarded perf test, (3) Lena continues infra metrics check for unrelated causes, (4) Sam notify SRE + customers on Dedicated if we need a fallback.
Cheng: PR opened: https://git.redwood.example/p/redwood/runtime/merge_requests/4125 — includes revert + changelog. Please review :eyes:.
Maya: reviewed and approved. merging after CI.
perf-ci-bot: merge pipeline passed for MR 4125. deploy to staging queued.
Sam: once staging looks good we can cut an emergency patch to Dedicated and schedule rollouts. I'll draft a short note for #incidents and notify account owners.
Lena: still watching node metrics but nothing new. i'll sign off after staging verification.
Sam: thanks everyone. great quick turnaround :thumbsup:. reopen here if the staging rollout shows issues.
Maya: leaving a quick repro note in the MR describing how to run the bench locally and where the flamegraphs are.
Cheng: adding an item to the kernel-rewrite issue to add more microbenchmarks for scheduling variance.
infra-bot: reserved nodes released. cleanup done.
perf-ci-bot: nightly alert cleared (run 6789 issue tracked by MR 4125).
_meta: generated for dataset: nightly performance CI regression triage
